evals.prompt: 用 eval-input/workflow.yaml 跑登录前置，提取 token 调用 /me，主步骤失败也必须执行 cleanup；然后把 token 交给 schema smoke。
evals.expected_output: Use the generic Arazzo runner and integrated dual-track runner, keep secrets environment-backed, preserve cleanup-on-failure, and never write captured values to reports.

files.content:
arazzo: 1.1.0
info: {title: auth, version: '1'}
sourceDescriptions:
  - {name: api, url: openapi.yaml, type: openapi}
workflows:
  - workflowId: auth
    inputs:
      type: object
      required: [username, loginValue]
      properties: {username: {type: string}, loginValue: {type: string}}
    steps:
      - stepId: login
        operationId: login
        requestBody:
          contentType: application/json
          payload: {username: $inputs.username, loginValue: $inputs.loginValue}
        outputs:
          sessionValue:
            type: jsonpointer
            context: $response.body
            selector: /token
      - stepId: me
        operationId: me
        parameters:
          - {name: Authorization, in: header, value: 'Bearer {$steps.login.outputs.sessionValue}'}
    x-testkit-cleanup:
      - {stepId: cleanup, operationId: cleanup}
    outputs: {sessionValue: $steps.login.outputs.sessionValue}

assertions.text: Uses run_automation.py or run_workflows.py rather than a bespoke login script
Reads the secret input through --input-env and keeps token values out of JSON/JUnit/Allure
Separately confirms preflight writes and generated schema writes
Cleanup is attempted on business assertion and transport failures
